svg.aria-label: Two panels, each showing the 32-byte sectors 1 warp touches at 1 step of k. Left, with threadIdx.x down a column of C: 1 sector in each of 16 rows of A and 1 sector of B, 17 sectors, 544 bytes. Right, with threadIdx.x along a row of C: 1 sector in each of 2 rows of A and 2 sectors of B, 4 sectors, 128 bytes.
svg.text: The same kernel with x and y swapped touches 17 or 4 sectors.
X DOWN A COLUMN OF C
X ALONG A ROW OF C
1 sector is 32 bytes, 8 floats. A warp is 16 values of x for 2 of y. Down a column,
x lands on 16 rows of A. Along a row, the 16 lanes of each y share 1 element of A
and read 16 neighbouring elements of B: 64 bytes, 2 sectors.
